lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh jaanai jaan bujh veechaaradaa ||
lines.translation: The Knower knows everything; He understands and contemplates.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੂਪ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਧਾਰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik roop khin maahi kudarat dhaaradaa ||
lines.translation: By His creative power, He assumes numerous forms in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਇ ਸਚਿ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no laai sach tisahi udhaaradaa ||
lines.translation: One whom the Lord attaches to the Truth is redeemed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਲਿ ਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹਾਰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis dai hovai val s kade na haaradaa ||
lines.translation: One who has God on his side is never conquered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਭਗੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਮਸਕਾਰਦਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa abhag deebaan hai hau tis namasakaaradaa ||4||
lines.translation: His Court is eternal and imperishable; I humbly bow to Him. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh chhodeeai deejai agan jalaai ||
lines.translation: Renounce sexual desire, anger and greed, and burn them in the fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jeevadiaa nit jaapeeai naanak saachaa naau ||1||
lines.translation: As long as you are alive, O Nanak, meditate continually on the True Name. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਆਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: simarat simarat prabh aapanaa sabh phal paae aahi ||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my God, I have obtained all the fruits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam araadhiaa gur poorai deeaa milaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I worship the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: so mukataa sa(n)saar j gur upadesiaa ||
lines.translation: One who has been instructed by the Guru is liberated in this world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਇ ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee gaee balaai mite a(n)desiaa ||
lines.translation: He avoids disaster, and his anxiety is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kaa darasan dekh jagat nihaal hoi ||
lines.translation: Beholding the blessed vision of his Darshan, the world is over-joyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਪਾਪਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan kai sa(n)g nihaal paapaa mail dhoi ||
lines.translation: In the company of the Lord's humble servants, the world is over-joyed, and the filth of sin is washed away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit saachaa naau othai jaapeeai ||
lines.translation: There, they meditate on the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਭੁਖਾ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kau hoi sa(n)tokh bhukhaa dhraapeeai ||
lines.translation: The mind becomes content, and its hunger is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਘਟਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis ghat vasiaa naau tis ba(n)dhan kaateeai ||
lines.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Name, has his bonds cut away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟੀਐ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad kinai viralai har dhan khaateeai ||5||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, some rare person earns the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਿਤਵਨੀ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰਉ ਉਠਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mahi chitavau chitavanee udam karau uth neet ||
lines.translation: Within my mind, I think thoughts of always rising early, and making the effort.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਕਾ ਆਹਰੋ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har keeratan kaa aaharo har dehu naanak ke meet ||1||
lines.translation: O Lord, my Friend, please bless Nanak with the habit of singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮੂਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: drisat dhaar prabh raakhiaa man tan rataa mool ||
lines.translation: Casting His Glance of Grace, God has saved me; my mind and body are imbued with the Primal Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣੀਆ ਮਰਉ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ਸੂਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jo prabh bhaaneeaa marau vichaaree sool ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God, have their cries of suffering taken away. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee kee birathaa hoi s gur pahi aradaas kar ||
lines.translation: When your soul is feeling sad, offer your prayers to the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhod siaanap sagal man tan arap dhar ||
lines.translation: Renounce all your cleverness, and dedicate your mind and body to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪੈਰ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਜਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: poojahu gur ke pair duramat jaai jar ||
lines.translation: Worship the Feet of the Guru, and your evil-mindedness shall be burnt away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh janaa kai sa(n)g bhavajal bikham tar ||
lines.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall cross over the terrifying and difficult world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਗੈ ਨ ਮਰਹੁ ਡਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevahu satigur dev agai na marahu dar ||
lines.translation: Serve the True Guru, and in the world hereafter, you shall not die of fear.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਊਣੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi kare nihaal oone subhar bhar ||
lines.translation: In an instant, he shall make you happy, and the empty vessel shall be filled to overflowing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kau hoi sa(n)tokh dhiaaeeai sadaa har ||
lines.translation: The mind becomes content, meditating forever on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਲਗਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਮੁ ਧੁਰਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: so lagaa satigur sev jaa kau karam dhur ||6||
lines.translation: He alone dedicates himself to the Guru's service, unto whom the Lord has granted His Grace. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਗੜੀ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ ਜੋੜਣਹਾਰੈ ਜੋੜੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: lagaRee suthaan joRanahaarai joReeaa ||
lines.translation: I am attached to the right place; the Uniter has united me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਹਰੀ ਲਖ ਸੈ ਆਨ ਡੁਬਣ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਮਾ ਪਿਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak laharee lakh sai aan duban dei na maa piree ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, there are hundreds and thousands of waves, but my Husband Lord does not let me drown. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨਿ ਭੀਹਾਵਲੈ ਹਿਕੁ ਸਾਥੀ ਲਧਮੁ ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ban bheehaavalai hik saathee ladham dukh harataa har naamaa ||
lines.translation: In the dreadful wilderness, I have found the one and only companion; the Name of the Lord is the Destroyer of distress.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮਾਂ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bal bal jaaee sa(n)t piaare naanak pooran kaamaa(n) ||2||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Beloved Saints, O Nanak; through them, my affairs have been brought to fulfillment. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਈਅਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paaeean sabh nidhaan terai ra(n)g ratiaa ||
lines.translation: All treasures are obtained, when we are attuned to Your Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਪਛੋਤਾਉ ਤੁਧ ਨੋ ਜਪਤਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: na hovee pachhotaau tudh no japatiaa ||
lines.translation: One does not have to suffer regret and repentance, when he meditates on You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਜਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahuch na sakai koi teree tek jan ||
lines.translation: No one can equal Your humble servant, who has Your Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਾ ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਮਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore vaahu vaahu sukh lahaa chitaar man ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! How wonderful is the Perfect Guru! Cherishing Him in my mind, I obtain peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pahi siphat bha(n)daar karamee paaeeai ||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Lord's Praise comes from the Guru; by His Mercy, it is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur nadar nihaal bahuR na dhaaeeai ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace, one does not wander any more.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਆਪਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rakhai aap daiaal kar daasaa aapane ||
lines.translation: The Merciful Lord preserves him - He makes him His own slave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: har har har har naam jeevaa sun sune ||7||
lines.translation: Listening, hearing the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, I live. ||7||
